summary: MannKind Corp filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of common stock and pre-funded warrants to institutional accredited investors, raising $50.0 million in gross proceeds. The offering is a routine capital raise for general corporate purposes, including a contingent value rights payment related to FDA approval of a drug. There is no change of control, strategic review, or special-situation event; the filing solely concerns an unregistered sale of equity securities with standard registration rights. As a routine financing and not an event-driven special situation, the filing does not warrant classification under a special-situations category.
